name: Iris opens
look: A section that sits on a new ground rises into the screen covered by the old ground; a disc opens in the middle of what is visible, widening with a hairline accent ring at its edge, until the section's own ground and words have appeared through it.
reduced: The section stands on its own ground, no cover, no ring.
phone: The section stands on its own ground, no cover, no ring.
